# Contribution rules of @haugoug

These rules apply to the files owned by @haugoug in
[CODEOWNERS](../CODEOWNERS). Where they differ from the default guidelines in
[CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md), these rules take precedence;
everything else in that file still applies.

## Issues first

Bug reports and feature requests are preferred over pull requests. A clear
issue, with a way to reproduce the problem or a description of the hardware
behaviour you need, is usually the fastest way to get a change into the
models.

This is especially true for AI-generated pull requests: instead of sending the
generated change, open an issue that describes the problem or the feature.

## Pull requests

Pull requests are still accepted, including AI-generated ones. Every pull request goes through an AI-based
review before it can be merged. During this review, the changes will be
reworked, so the merged code may differ from the code of the pull request.
